name: AutoArtikel ID
author: Drofu

sections.description:
AutoArtikel ID is a WordPress plugin that helps you generate and publish AI-assisted articles automatically. By connecting your WordPress site to AutoArtikel ID backend, this plugin allows you to create articles in bulk or on a schedule, saving you time and effort.

Language and Regional Availability
AutoArtikel ID is currently intended for use on Indonesian websites. At this stage, only Indonesian and English are supported. Additional languages and wider regional availability will be introduced soon.

With AutoArtikel ID, you can:
– Generate article titles and content ideas with AI.
– Create and manage templates for article tone, call-to-action (CTA), images, and publishing schedules.
– Set up publishing queues to automatically schedule and publish your articles.
– Monitor upcoming posts, trigger articles to be generated immediately, and check articles that have already been posted.

Unlike other plugins, you don’t need to provide an API key to use AutoArtikel ID. It integrates seamlessly with AutoArtikel ID, which handles the content generation for you.

The plugin works in sync with the AutoArtikel ID service to handle the heavy lifting of content generation, while you manage everything directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Requirements

This plugin relies on the AutoArtikel ID API. You need an active AutoArtikel ID plan for the site you are connecting. Without valid credentials, the plugin will remain in read-only mode.

External services

This plugin communicates with AutoArtikel ID services to generate content and manage quotas:

  • Service: AutoArtikel ID API (https://api.artikel.drofu.com/api/v1)
  • Purpose: authenticate the site, generate titles/articles, sync queue status, and receive webhook callbacks for completed jobs and payments.
  • Data sent: site URL/domain, configured templates (tone/topic/keyword/CTA/image options), publish schedule, title/article prompts, and license identifiers. Payment events use Xendit callbacks when enabled.
  • Terms: https://artikel.drofu.com/terms-and-conditions/
  • Privacy: https://artikel.drofu.com/privacy-policy/

All calls use HTTPS and HMAC-signed callbacks. Generated HTML is saved locally as WordPress posts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the autoartikel-id folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the AutoArtikel ID menu in wp-admin. Complete the onboarding wizard by signing in or creating a AutoArtikel ID account.
  4. Configure templates, generate titles, and schedule publishing according to your AutoArtikel ID quota.
sections.faq:
Do I need a AutoArtikel ID account?

Yes. All generation features call the AutoArtikel ID API. Without credentials you can browse the UI but cannot generate titles or articles.

Where is content processing performed?

Article generation runs on AutoArtikel ID infrastructure. The plugin queues jobs, polls status, and syncs the final HTML back into WordPress.

What data is sent to AutoArtikel ID?

Template metadata, drafted titles, and scheduling information are transmitted to the AutoArtikel ID API over HTTPS. Generated HTML is stored locally as posts. No analytics or telemetry are collected beyond operational logs.

Can I use the plugin on multiple sites?

Each site must be verified within your AutoArtikel ID account. Licensing and quotas are enforced per site.
